cases.title: With the UCS rotated 30 degrees, a pit placed right after CD comes in square (rotation 0), not turned by the UCS
cases.expected: After _.UCS _Z 30 (UCSXDIR reads about 0.866,0.5), CD from world 150000,-96000 to world 170000,-96000 (levels 18.000 / 17.900) and then PIT at world 175000,-90000 with cover 19.000 and manual rotation 0: exactly one new pit block within 700 mm of 175000,-90000, and its rotation reads 0 radians, not 0.5236. The drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: The fault came from AutoCAD's live UCS during a CE command; only a real insert under a rotated UCS shows the block's stored rotation.
not_automated: The root cause the carpark names (where the rotation came from) is not chased; this case proves only the safety net. The log line 'PIT BUG-035: forcing pit rotation' is recorded through history, not required.
Align to pipe and Align to building orientations are not driven. Whether the pit label and cover text are square is not read.

cases.title: Edit Pipe on a drawn 8 m pipe: switching the first IL text from Above to Below moves it under the pipe, and it stays there
cases.expected: CD from 150000,-96000 to 158000,-96000 (levels 18.000 / 17.920, both IL texts Above, label on): the IL 18.000 text near 150000,-96000 sits above the line (y > -96000). CDEDIT on that pipe opens Edit Pipe; with the first end's Above switched off and Edit pipe, Save, exactly one IL 18.000 text is near 150000,-96000 and it now sits below the line (y < -96000). The IL 17.920 text stays above (y > -96000). No second IL 18.000 text is left behind. The drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: The fault was the live clash check on the real drawing undoing the edit; only a drawn pipe edited in the real Edit Pipe window shows where the text ends up.
not_automated: The second end, the pipe label off, a 1-2 m pipe (leader route) and a genuine clash that should still flip the text are not driven.
The missing word "Below" in Edit Pipe (E11) is a Codex look; this case only checks the toggle moves the text.
